name: PDX Cubing for Causes 2020

venue.name: [Daimler Trucks North America Convention Center](https://www.daimler.com/career/about-us/locations/location-detail-page-5111.html)
venue.details: Rooms A-C, entrance on the right of the Daimler Lobby. Daimler HQ building is a large 10 floor building.

information: Proceeds from this competition will benefit the charities Oregon with Love and SchoolHouse Supplies. Daimler Trucks North America will make a 100% match of the donation made for this competition. This event is supported by PING (Parent In Networking Group) and STEM Employee Interest Groups. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PDXCubingforCauses2020#13083-competitor-responsibilities) tab. **Join our facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!** [![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/8uf2SCt.png)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085/)
